title: asplenium subglandulosum subsp. hispanicum
intro: Asplenium subglandulosum subsp. hispanicum, commonly known as Iberian spleenwort, is a subspecies of fern belonging to the Asplenium genus. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to provide health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Iberian spleenwort include its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an expectorant, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
